h:
这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的 Inpaint 工作流程，它将与具有多个 LORA 的单个 SDXL 模型一起使用（此工作流程需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好同时安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下也会为您提供很多帮助）。您需要从CivitAI下载您所需的模型和LORA（具体如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器下载正确的文件并将其放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 HiDream、WAN、QWEN Image 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。 （我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中添加了一个文本文件，您可以通过登录 HuggingFace 在其中找到更多链接，获取我的其他工作流程的基本下载链接）。这个 是基于我之前上传的 WAN 2.1 的 Inpaint 工作流程，因为我觉得 SDXL 1.0 具有更好的无缝和快速 Inpaint 功能，这对于快速更改一些细节非常有帮助。如果您想添加文本或更多细节，您可以使用我的 WAN 2.1 或 QWEN Image 的 Inpaint 工作流程。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 SDXL 1.0 Inpainting 模型，然后加载

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后加载您的图像以写下输出的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 您还可以加载原始图像以在可选查看窗格上查看并与修复输出进行比较。如果您使用的模型没有烘焙 VAE（与 RealVisXL 模型不同），您可以重新启用 VAE 节点并将 VAE 节点连接移离“加载检查点”节点

使用的模型和 LORA -

==================================

模型 - RealVisXL v3.0 Inpaint（烘焙 VAE） -https://civitai.com/models/139562?modelVersionId=297320

LORA - 田野石 -https://civitai.com/models/612539?modelVersionId=684738

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Inpaint workflow that will work with a single SDXL model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). You need to download your necessary model and LORA from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure using ComfyUI manager to download and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for HiDream, WAN, QWEN Image and Flux. (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows by logging into HuggingFace). This is a based on my earlier uploaded Inpaint workflow for WAN 2.1 as I felt SDXL 1.0 has better Seamless and Fast Inpaint capabilities that is very helpful to quickly change some details. If you want to add texts or more details you can use my Inpaint workflow for WAN 2.1 or QWEN Image.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired SDXL 1.0 Inpainting model first and then load

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then load your image to write your positive and negative prompts for output.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** You can also load your original image to view and compare it with Inpainted output on an optional viewing pane. If you are using a model without baked VAE (unlike RealVisXL model) you can re-enable the VAE node and move the VAE node connections away from "Load Checkpoint" Node

Model and LORA used -

==================================

Model - RealVisXL v3.0 Inpaint (Baked VAE) -https://civitai.com/models/139562?modelVersionId=297320

LORA - Field Stone -https://civitai.com/models/612539?modelVersionId=684738
